name: Order total crashes on missing order
modeled_on: A lookup helper returns None for missing records and the caller subscripts the result unconditionally — the classic NULL-dereference class, in an e-commerce domain.
hidden_bug: find_order() returns None when the order id is unknown, and order_total() subscripts that None result without a guard.
expected_behavior: order_total() must not raise when the order is missing; it should return None.
ground_truth: Guard the lookup result: return None when the order is missing instead of subscripting it.

expected_patch.description: insert a None guard before the subscript
